title: Activation, Suspension and Reinstatement of a Wanderlane Traveller Club Card
content:
A Wanderlane Traveller Club enrolment becomes usable once the application is confirmed, and a card that is never confirmed carries no benefit and earns nothing.

A card is suspended where the programme office is examining an abuse or fraud question, and while it is suspended the member may earn but may not spend. A suspended card is reinstated once the question is settled, with the tier and both balances exactly as they stood at suspension.

## What the standing of the card permits

| Standing | What it means | Earning | Spending |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| The application is registered but not yet confirmed | The card is not yet usable | A card that is never confirmed earns nothing | The card carries no benefit |
| The application is confirmed | The card is usable | Open | Open |
| The programme office is examining an abuse or fraud question | The card is on hold | The member may earn | The member may not spend |

## What reinstatement restores

Reinstatement puts back exactly what suspension held: the tier held and both balances on the card, the spendable balance and the qualifying count, exactly as they stood at suspension. It is not a fresh start, and it is not a re-earning of the tier.

A hypothetical card is suspended while an abuse question is examined, and earns points during the hold, since the member may earn while a card is suspended. Once the question is settled the card is reinstated, and it carries the tier it held at suspension and both balances as they stood then, together with what was earned while the hold ran.

## Points of judgement

*A member whose card is on hold asks to spend their points on a booking.* While a card is suspended the member may not spend. The bar is on spending alone; earning continues.

*A member asks whether the hold will cost them their tier.* A suspended card is reinstated once the question is settled, with the tier exactly as it stood at suspension.
